why_not_executed: Charter A3 freezes local-q4km as a recorded chart line, not a live arm. It is drawn for comparison and never run: the 1060 is the hardware v2 exists to escape, and re-running it would make the baseline drift against the thing it is supposed to hold still.

source.transcript_note: plans/ is gitignored (A11), so these values are copied here to keep the reference line readable from a fresh checkout. This file is the tracked record; the transcript is the provenance.
source.conditions: local-q4km on the GTX 1060, -c 3072, EMPTY_RETRIES=4, k=3 draws per cell

not_recorded.retrieval: No retrieval vector is frozen for this arm. Retrieval is config-independent of the generation model, so the gate compares retrieval against the live production arm, never against this line.
not_recorded.mean_fabricated_events: Demoted by R27 -- the judge reproduces its own count 50% of the time. The boolean fabrication_rate above is kept; the count is not.

reading_rule: A chart line, not a threshold. Nothing is promoted or blocked by comparison against this arm, and its numbers were produced by a different judge run on a different generator -- they are not commensurable with a candidate's.
